title: Negative binomial regression by IRLS and Newton-Raphson — nbreg
text: model \(Y_i \sim NB(\mu_i, \theta)\) \(\log \mu_i = x_i^\top \beta + o_i\), \(E(Y_i) = \mu_i\) \(Var(Y_i) = \mu_i + \mu_i^2 / \theta\). small \(\theta\) means much spread Poisson model; \(\theta \\infty\) model becomes Poisson. fit alternates two stages log-likelihood, coefficients \(\log\theta\) stop changing (see nbreg_control()): IRLS coefficients, theta held fixed. round computes weights \(w_i = a_i \theta \mu_i / (\theta + \mu_i)\) working response \(z_i = (\eta_i - o_i) + (y_i - \mu_i)/\mu_i\) solves weighted least-squares problem. Newton-Raphson theta, coefficients held fixed. Steps taken \(\log\theta\), using slope curvature log-likelihood (built digamma() trigamma()), line search guarantees log-likelihood increases. Every step checked: step lower log-likelihood, lead infinite invalid values, halved acceptable. log-likelihood always evaluated exactly. Starting values come Poisson IRLS fit moment-type estimate theta. Standard errors coefficients come \((X^\top W X)^{-1}\) convergence, treating theta known, MASS::glm.nb() ; standard error theta comes curvature log-likelihood theta. Response values within 1e-8 whole number accepted rounding error rounded fitting.
